params.name: networkrate
params.description: Data transfer rate in megabits per second allowed

params.name: networkmode
params.description: Indicates the mode with which the network will operate. Valid option: NATTED or ROUTED

params.name: traffictype
params.description: The traffic type for the network offering. Supported type in current release is GUEST only

params.name: availability
params.description: The availability of network offering. The default value is Optional.  Another value is Required, which will make it as the default network offering for new networks

params.name: supportedservices
params.description: Services supported by the network offering

params.name: fornsx
params.description: true if network offering is meant to be used for NSX, false otherwise.

params.name: displaytext
params.description: The display text of the network offering, defaults to the value of 'name'.

params.name: conservemode
params.description: True if the network offering is IP conserve mode enabled

params.name: zoneid
params.description: The ID of the containing zone(s), null for public offerings

params.name: servicecapabilitylist
params.description: Desired service capabilities as part of network offering

params.name: domainid
params.description: The ID of the containing domain(s), null for public offerings

params.name: keepaliveenabled
params.description: If true keepalive will be turned on in the loadbalancer. At the time of writing this has only an effect on haproxy; the mode http and httpclose options are unset in the haproxy conf file.

params.name: nsxsupportlb
params.description: True if network offering for NSX network offering supports Load balancer service.

params.name: specifyasnumber
params.description: true if network offering supports choosing AS number

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the network offering

params.name: nsxsupportsinternallb
params.description: True if network offering for NSX network offering supports Internal Load balancer service.

params.name: guestiptype
params.description: Guest type of the network offering: Shared or Isolated

params.name: serviceproviderlist
params.description: Provider to service mapping. If not specified, the provider for the service will be mapped to the default provider on the physical network

params.name: enable
params.description: Set to true if the offering is to be enabled during creation. Default is false

params.name: maxconnections
params.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections supported by the Network offering

params.name: forvpc
params.description: True if network offering is meant to be used for VPC, false otherwise.

params.name: provider
params.description: Name of the provider providing the service

params.name: routingmode
params.description: the routing mode for the network offering. Supported types are: Static or Dynamic.

params.name: internetprotocol
params.description: The internet protocol of network offering. Options are IPv4 and dualstack. Default is IPv4. dualstack will create a network offering that supports both IPv4 and IPv6

params.name: fortungsten
params.description: True if network offering is meant to be used for Tungsten-Fabric, false otherwise.

params.name: egressdefaultpolicy
params.description: True if guest network default egress policy is allow; false if default egress policy is deny

params.name: ispersistent
params.description: True if network offering supports persistent networks; defaulted to false if not specified

params.name: tags
params.description: The tags for the network offering.

params.name: serviceofferingid
params.description: The service offering ID used by virtual router provider

params.name: specifyvlan
params.description: True if network offering supports VLANs

params.name: details
params.description: Network offering details in key/value pairs. Supported keys are internallbprovider/publiclbprovider with service provider as a value, and promiscuousmode/macaddresschanges/forgedtransmits with true/false as value to accept/reject the security settings if available for a nic/portgroup

params.name: specifyipranges
params.description: True if network offering supports specifying ip ranges; defaulted to false if not specified
